name: Igoudar Dakhla green data centre complex
summary: State-led programme for a green data centre complex in Dakhla targeting 500 MW, unveiled by Morocco in November 2025 for AI and high-performance computing, to be powered by a dedicated solar and wind farm. In April 2026 two ministries, the Dakhla-Oued Ed-Dahab wilaya and regional council, the Mohammed VI Investment Fund and CDG signed an agreement launching the strategic studies that are to set its governance, economic model, phasing and financing. It is planned in two parts, a sovereign segment for national needs and a segment open to private investors. The sources give no investment figure, operator or schedule.

location.note: City coordinates from the Dakhla Wikipedia page; no site within Dakhla has been named. Dakhla is in Western Sahara (ISO code EH), a disputed territory administered by Morocco; the sources present the project as a Moroccan national programme.

notes: Still at the study stage: the April 2026 agreement launched the studies that precede any investment decision. A September 2026 article still described the campus as targeting 500 MW with no schedule. Coverage uses both the names Igoudar Dakhla and Igoudar Numérique for the programme.
